description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

Join NVIDIA’s ambitious team and be part of a legacy of innovation! We are seeking a Principal SW Architect, Networking to build the future of AI data-centers. This role is tailored for those passionate about collective communication, vertical co-development of AI networks, and large model training scalability. Your work will drive innovation and contribute to large-scale production, making a real impact on the world!

What you'll be doing:

  • Developing the next-gen Scale-up fabric for AI data-centers

  • Concentrating on collaborative communication and vertical co-development of AI networks alongside hardware, software, and applications

  • Guaranteeing scalability, reliability, and robust training for large model development

  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to build and implement innovative solutions

  • Creating innovative concepts that will ultimately proceed to full-scale manufacturing

  • Partnering with world-class talent to successfully implement new technologies

What we need to see:

  • 6+ experience in software architecture and networking

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or equivalent experience

  • Strong expertise in AI applied research

  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects and deliver flawless results

  • Excellent collaboration skills and the ability to work with diverse teams

  • A track record of innovation and the determination to compete at the highest level

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Advanced degree or equivalent experience in Engineering or a related area

  • Experience with large-scale AI data-center operations

  • Outstanding abilities in resiliency and tail-robust training methods

  • Proven ability to generate world-class innovations

  • Solid experience in collaborative development of AI networks within specific sectors

With competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely regarded as one of the most desirable technology employers in the world. Our teams are composed of some of the most forward‑thinking and driven engineers in the industry, and we continue to grow rapidly. If you are a senior data engineer passionate about building large‑scale, high‑impact data platforms, we’d love to hear from you.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 19, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy. 

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.
